Vendored third-party libraries (used for on-device photo conversion):
- libheif.js (libheif compiled to JavaScript) - LGPL-3.0, https://github.com/strukturag/libheif
  Unmodified library, dynamically loaded; source available at the project above.
- jpeg-js - BSD-3-Clause, https://github.com/jpeg-js/jpeg-js

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
onnxruntime-web (Microsoft) — MIT License.
  vendor/onnxruntime-web/ — the WebAssembly build (single-threaded SIMD
  kernel plus its Node entry point). Chosen over the native binding because
  it needs no Visual C++ runtime, which a freshly installed Windows lacks.

U^2-Net ("u2netp") — Apache License 2.0.
  Qin et al., "U2-Net: Going Deeper with Nested U-Structure for Salient
  Object Detection" (Pattern Recognition, 2020).
  vendor/models/u2netp.onnx — weights as distributed by the rembg project
  (Daniel Gatis, MIT License). Used locally, on the family's own machine,
  to cut clothing photos out of their background. No image is uploaded.

--------------------------------------------------------------------------
yt-dlp — Unlicense (public domain).
  vendor/yt-dlp/yt-dlp.exe — the standalone Windows build (it carries its own
  Python), unmodified, from the release pinned in tools/yt-dlp.pin and
  verified against that release's published sha256 at build time. It runs
  only on this machine, only when someone adds a song from a link.
